entities.name: SLC5A1
observations: Encodes intestinal apical sodium/glucose cotransporter SGLT1, which couples uptake of one glucose molecule to two sodium ions.
Glucose-sodium cotransport supports intestinal fluid absorption and underlies oral rehydration therapy.

entities.name: ORS uses SGLT1
observations: Oral rehydration glucose is absorbed predominantly by apical intestinal SGLT1, with 2 Na+ transported per glucose molecule.
